title: Make People Care Before You Explain

slides.headline: Your launch video shouldn't explain your product.
slides.accentText: Give people a reason to care.

slides.title: The same launch. On repeat.
slides.footer: Plenty of information. No reason to care.

slides.headline: Existence doesn't create interest.
slides.body: People care when they recognize a problem they want solved. Start with the frustration in their world.

slides.title: Sell the problem first.
items: Show the frustration customers live with
Show life when that problem is solved
Show why this product needed to exist
slides.footer: The product becomes interesting when its impact becomes clear.

slides.leftBody: Explains the mechanics: features, screens and workflows.
slides.rightBody: Creates desire and curiosity about the change the product makes.
slides.footer: Give people a reason to take the next step. Let the demo handle the details.

slides.title: Why does every launch look the same?
slides.footer: Different products, founders and problems. The same creative direction.

slides.title: Let your story shape the launch.
items: The people you're solving it for
The founder's reason for building it
The change you want to create

slides.headline: Create curiosity.
slides.body: The demo explains how it works. The launch makes people care enough to find out.
